case quirk/comment-leak
  note      LIVE DEFECT, pinned deliberately. parseGcodeToMove has no comment
  note      handling, so "X50" inside the trailing comment overwrites the real X10.
  note      parseGcodeWaveform DOES break on ";" (gcode.ts:123) — the two parsers
  note      disagree. Currently unreachable in the app because standalone comments
  note      are skipped and no emitted trailing comment carries a letter+digit
  note      token. Fixing it should change this snapshot from x=50 to x=10.
  in        G1 X10 F5 ; X50 fast
  in.len    1
  gauge     15
  out.len   1
  bytes     81 b2 40 20 4e 00 00 00 8B | move g=1 x=65 f=5 p=0
